target.title: feat: consume shared OpenClaw design tokens
target.body:
## Summary

- load the shared OpenClaw palette from `@openclaw/design-system`
- remove duplicated dark and light foundational color tokens from `Layout.astro`
- preserve site-specific effects, typography, theme behavior, and rendered output
- add a regression test preventing foundational palette values from moving back into the consumer

## Validation

- `bun test` (27 passed)
- `bun run build`
- real Chromium screenshots for `/`, `/integrations/`, and `/blog/` in dark/light at 1440px and 390px
- computed shared tokens match latest `main`
- 11/12 screenshot pairs are pixel-identical; the remaining pair differs by 194 channels with max delta 2 and identical dimensions
- no horizontal overflow

## Stack

Base: `pe/claw-485-design-system-install`

This remains a draft while `openclaw/design-system` is private because hosted installs require cross-repository credentials or a public repository.
